title: Java Core Fundamentals
goal: Rebuild confidence in writing plain Java without Spring.

topics.title: Classes and objects
topics.description: Separate a class definition from the identity and state of each instance.
learningGoals: Separate a class definition from the identity and state of each instance.
Explain Identity, State and Behavior.
Demonstrate a valid operation and a boundary or failure case.
examples: Create two GiftCard objects with different balances. Spend from one and verify the other is unchanged.

tasks.title: Explain Classes and objects in your own words
Work through the example and predict the result
Check a boundary or failure case without AI implementation help
